source: Anthropic first-party API list prices, as listed in the Claude API reference bundled with Claude Code 2.1.302 (price table cached 2026-10-06).
notes: Input and output prices are from that table.
cache_read uses the price the table states where it states one (Opus 5.5 0.20, Sonnet 5.5 0.20, Fable 5.1 0.25). Elsewhere it is 0.1 times input.
cache_write is 1.25 times input (the 5 minute cache write rate). The table does not list it.
Both arms bill a subscription through CLIProxyAPI, so these dollars are notional. The same formula is used for every arm.
A model id prefixed with a proxy account (for example neu/claude-sonnet-5-5) uses the price of the id without the prefix.
